_doc: W7-7 PR 4b (#1247, R-5; the owner's S6): every site that can take the element holding the keys away under them, and what witnesses its landing: a fact that names the site ('Class.Method'), 'guard: <scope>' for a site inside a guarded scope that neither is nor holds a region root, or 'exempt: <reason>'. Plan 47 CB-17a (#1866, CD11): a site that can turn a control off with the keys on it (each IsEnabled trigger by its condition, an IsEnabled binding or write, and every command button, 'xaml-command' and 'command') takes only 'keys-first: Class.Method' (a fact whose own code names the site, a trigger's condition token or an unnamed button's command, and calls KeysFirstRecorder.AssertTheKeysLeaveFirst), 'stays-on: Class.Method' (CB-17b: the same, for a control that used to go off under the keys and now stays on, calling KeysFirstRecorder.AssertItStaysOn with what, root, act and reached), 'exempt: not focusable', 'exempt: always on: Type.Property' (read from every construction of every property of that name), 'exempt: its own press never turns it off: <why>' or 'exempt: never fires: <why> (Class.Method)'. A keys-first or stays-on fact that can skip at run time (read by following its calls by name) or has a skipped or explicit data row witnesses nothing; only the menu's seventeen rows, whose facts skip where a desktop refuses a menu the keys, are written 'keys-first, where a desktop gives a menu the keys (#1680): Class.Method', and each of them is. A row CB-17b ended (EndedByCb17b) takes only keys-first, stays-on, always on or not focusable, and a key it deleted with its trigger (GoneWithCb17b) never comes back. The press exemption's limit: a command-bound control has its keys moved first whoever turns it off (CommandKeysFirst, CB-17b); for an IsEnabled trigger, binding or write, and a Click button, another driver (a refresh's or a rescan's deselect, an in-place change of item, a find bar's mode switch) can still turn such a control off under the keys, and this census does not judge other drivers (#1955). A menu row is no command site: its menu gives the keys back before its command runs (MenuRowCommandTests). FocusIntegrityManifestCensus scrapes the sites and judges each witness; SLATE_FOCUS_MANIFEST_UPDATE=1 rewrites this file, keeping every assignment.
